style: Original detailed pixel-art fantasy panoramas, wide 16:9, no UI, text or watermark

assets.description: Detailed isometric medieval capital panorama: stone keep, russet-roof timber houses, river crossing, distant mountains, open foreground development plots.
Hidden woodland goblin camp: patched ochre tents, sharpened palisade, campfire, supply crates and crude watchtower.
Marshland troll den: mossy rock cave, teal pools, twisted roots, bone totems and hulking trolls.
Mountain giant stronghold: colossal stone walls, heavy gate, towers, boulders and giants, snowy peaks.
Remote titan sanctuary: monumental temple carved into a colossal seated stone figure, terraces, waterfalls, mist and faint golden glow.
